question: Can selective SMD membrane inhibition reversibly suppress neural variation and the SMD-transmitted body wiggle, with recovery on release?
authorization: User requests a4h run after proposing SMD neuron inhibition/release; frozen diagnostic, not parameter training
motivation: E081 SMD NMJ release hold body ratio0.1137801463, timestep-consistent; neural dynamics were not directly inhibited
fixed: All302-neuron parameters, topology, NMJ weights/signs/normalization, sensory system and water/body/muscle mechanics, physical clocks. Original checkpoint and reference data unchanged.
method: SMD-targeted additional membrane conductance with-80mV reversal; live voltage/gates/recurrence/sensory feedback and original voltage-to-NMJ transform. No voltage freeze, NMJ replacement, muscle gate, external pacer or weight fitting.
screen: 11 nominal60s trials: sham; whole SMD group at.003/.01/.03/.1nS; each of SMDDL/SMDDR/SMDVL/SMDVR at.1nS; dorsal pair and ventral pair at.1nS. Inhibit30..40s, assess35..40s, recovery50..60s.
selection: Among safe matched-prefix cases with>=5mV mean hyperpolarization in every targeted cell, prioritize preserved baseline/recovery, then lowest maximum body-range ratio, then smaller conductance. A selected case is not automatically a successful target.
confirmation: Selected case plus matched sham: onset shifted to37..47s in67s trial; repeated30..40s and80..90s in120s trial; long hold30..90s in150s trial with recovery130..150s. Six trials.
refinement: Selected nominal case plus sham at neural-half and body-half grids; four trials. Ordinary dt.002s/brain.1ms; halves.05ms or.001s respectively.

criteria.evidence: Verify copied input manifest/model hashes; full coordinates exactly reconstruct pinned checkpoint. Ordinary sham matches original up to60s, intervention prefix before first event matches original<=1e-8. Same-grid paired clocks/prefix must match; all recorded values finite.
criteria.safety: Both sham/test abs joints<.5rad and voltages between-100 and60mV
criteria.movement_preservation: Every pre/recovery window retains regional cycle amplitude>=max(.003rad,.8matched sham) and regional frequencies1.62..1.98Hz
criteria.neural_access: Each targeted cell mean voltage shift<=-5mV; aggregate targeted-cell centered voltage RMS ratio<=.2, with individual std/p2p values retained
criteria.body_suppression: Maximum raw joint-range/sham ratio<=.2 in last5s of every hold. This is partial motor suppression, not strict rest.
criteria.strict_rest_separate: Report raw maximum joint range<=1e-4rad separately; partial access never qualifies learned stopping
criteria.numerical: Independent neural/body-half body ratio and targeted neural RMS ratio differences<=.05; safe/matched baseline. Full reversible-access flag additionally requires positive nominal, all three confirmations and both refined results.
criteria.scope: Engineering reversible neural control target only. No learned sensory start/stop, forward swimming, biological fidelity, bistability or isolated SMD pacemaker proof.

budget: Four concurrent CPU workers x4physical cores, float64 dedicated conda env, nohup.90min reserved after screen for confirmation/refinement;30min reserved for refinements. Outer process-group watchdog includes preparation,21 planned trials, reporting/cleanup. May finish early once planned trials complete.
